change: Wave accumulates qualified hand positions through a brief palm turn, requires at least five actual open observations and a currently open hand, and discards history after the existing neutral/rearm interval. Stationary stop still resets immediately on a non-open frame.

Wave amplitude, reversal count, time window and minimum open observation count

limits: Recorded model outputs prove policy behavior, not new TensorRT/video inference or a completed greeting.
